name: Obereshno, dveri zachynyayut'sya!
source:
Have you ever taken the subway? Maybe you are afraid of the roar of an underground train that disappears into the blackness of the tunnels? Or maybe you are comforted by this timeless space, where there is neither day nor night?...

They say that at night, when the subway is already closed, you can sometimes hear the sounds of a train. But it cannot be a train, because the last one has already passed? Besides, there is only sound. The train itself is never seen.

Superstitious workers say that this is a bad omen, and at night they try not to listen too much. But it seems that not everyone believes in it.

Do you believe?

[Translated from [url=https://dahuanna.itch.io/oberezhnodveri]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你坐过地铁吗？也许你害怕消失在黑暗隧道中的地铁的轰鸣声？或者也许你对这个既没有白天也没有黑夜的永恒空间感到安慰？…

他们说，晚上地铁已经关闭的时候，有时你会听到火车的声音。但不可能是火车，因为最后一班已经过去了？此外，只有声音。火车本身从未被见过。

迷信的工人说这是不祥之兆，晚上尽量不要听太多。但似乎并不是所有人都相信。

你相信吗？

[译自[url=https://dahuanna.itch.io/oberezhnodveri]itch.io[/url]]
